o: Friends take turns suggesting absurd "improvements" to each other's appearance
They are giving each other care tips
questions.e: In the video: "Nikad ti ovo nisam rekla, ali više bi mi se svidela da imaš..." — they take turns suggesting increasingly strange "improvements" to each other.

questions.q: What hairstyle is suggested to the first girl?
questions.e: In the video: "bi ti jako stajala lepo jedna šiška" — bangs would look really nice on you.

questions.q: What is suggested to be done with the teeth?
questions.e: In the video: "Za još bolji izgled sklonila sam dva zuba" — for an even better look I removed two teeth.

questions.q: What is suggested to add at the end?
questions.e: In the video: "Mislim da bi bilo mnogo lepše da imaš ovde rep" — I think it would be much nicer if you had a tail here.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Bi ti jako stajala lepo jedna *šiška*.
Da imaš ogroman *mladež* na desnom obrazu.

questions.e: Na in answer to "where?" requires the locative case: na desnom obrazu.
Na svetu — "in the world": locative case after na.
Sa ("with") requires the instrumental case: sa šiškom.
